component.name: sparq
component.description: sparq — SOTA Rust RDF + SPARQL engine. This is the checked-in VEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) source of truth; the release workflow stamps the released version into a per-release copy attached to the GitHub Release alongside the CycloneDX SBOM.

_comment: [OPUS-4.8] sq-toze.3 (GX-2): VEX justifying the advisories that cargo-deny is configured
to ignore in deny.toml. KEEP THIS IN SYNC WITH deny.toml [advisories].ignore — each entry
here corresponds 1:1 to an ignore there, with the same justification.
[OPUS-4.8] sq-g2xs: the sole prior entry, RUSTSEC-2025-0134 (`rustls-pemfile`), was REMOVED:
the federation HTTP client was migrated ureq 2 -> ureq 3, whose rustls-native-certs 0.8 no
longer depends on the archived `rustls-pemfile` (its code moved into rustls-pki-types'
PemObject). The crate left the tree, the deny.toml ignore was dropped, and this VEX entry was
removed to keep the 1:1 invariant. The list is now empty — when a future advisory needs a
justified ignore, add the deny.toml ignore AND the matching `not_affected` entry here together.
